tldr: Sun in the 3rd house: identity becomes personal through communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
body:
With the Sun in the 3rd house, this part of you develops through communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement. The Sun describes identity, vitality, confidence, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center. In practice, this brings attention to the conversations, questions, messages, errands, and local patterns that shape how you make sense of life.

When this placement is supported, your words and observations can become more useful and easier to trust. The Sun can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose.

When it is strained, your attention can scatter, or the same thought can loop without becoming a clear choice. The harder pattern can show up as over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
challenge: over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth around communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
